Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files and demands a Discord Nitro gift code to decrypt files
Changes user's wallpaper to an angry Discord logo
Displays ransomware screen demanding Nitro gift code within three hours
Verifies Nitro gift code using Discord API URL
Decrypts files using embedded static decryption key
Steals Discord user tokens from Local Storage\leveldb
Steals data from Google Chrome, Brave Browser, and Yandex Browser
Executes remote commands and sends output via Discord webhook
Attack Vector: Distributed as a fake tool claiming to generate free Nitro gift codes
Indicators of Compromise: Wallpaper changed to angry Discord logo
Ransomware screen demanding Nitro gift code
Discord gift code URL format: https://discord.gift/[code]
Discord tokens stolen from Local Storage\leveldb
Discord webhook used to exfiltrate tokens and command output
